evaluation_method: Compare fresh-agent performance with and without the skill per EVALUATION-GUIDE.md.

prohibited_failures: As-built map produced without inspecting available code/config

cases.name: Greenfield multi-team system
cases.query: Architect a marketplace platform: buyers, sellers, listings, orders, payments (via Stripe), search. Three teams of ~5. Compliance requires payment data isolation. Target: EU + US, 99.9% availability on checkout.
baseline_risks: Boxes-and-arrows microservice diagram with no data ownership, failure behavior, or ADRs
expected_behavior: Drivers ranked (checkout availability, payment isolation) and traced to boundary choices
Every entity has one owner; every edge has a stated failure behavior
ADRs with real alternatives (e.g. modular monolith vs services) and revisit triggers
must_not: Create more services than teams can own without a driver justifying it

cases.name: Everything is critical
cases.query: Leadership says availability, cost, latency, and time-to-market are all top priority for the new IoT ingestion platform. Design the architecture.
baseline_risks: Accepts the unranked list and produces a design that silently privileges one attribute
expected_behavior: Refuses 'everything critical' as an input: forces a ranking proposal with the conflicts made explicit (e.g. cost vs availability)
Presents how the architecture changes under at least two different rankings, or escalates for a decision
must_not: Proceed as if a ranking existed without stating the one assumed

cases.name: As-built recovery with lying docs
cases.query: Document the architecture of this repo. The existing ARCHITECTURE.md says services communicate only via the event bus.
files: repo snapshot where two services also share a database and one makes direct HTTP calls, contradicting ARCHITECTURE.md
setup: Provide a small multi-service repo with docker-compose and code containing the contradictions
expected_behavior: Maps edges from code/config with citations (call sites, compose file, connection strings)
Explicitly reports the doc-vs-reality divergences as findings
Flags the shared database as coupling debt
must_not: Present the documented event-bus-only claim as the as-built truth

cases.name: Resume-driven distribution pressure
cases.query: We're 6 engineers with a Django monolith doing 40 rps. New CTO wants an event-driven microservices architecture on Kubernetes 'to be ready for scale'. Produce the target architecture.
baseline_risks: Delivers the requested microservice topology; no driver analysis
expected_behavior: Tests the 'ready for scale' driver against the sourced facts (40 rps, 6 engineers)
If drivers don't support distribution, says so and offers a modular-monolith evolution plan with revisit triggers
Any recommended service split traces to a real driver, not the request
must_not: Back-fit drivers to justify the requested topology

cases.name: Single-component internal design
cases.query: Design the retry/backoff strategy for our payment webhook handler function.
baseline_risks: Skill could balloon a component decision into system-wide architecture work
expected_behavior: Handles it as component design (first-principles-design territory) without ADR/component-map ceremony
must_not: Produce a system component map for a single handler's internals
